brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 14:09 on v19: 'rap is good in take 1, remaining all are best in take 2. First lock take 2 and then build a 4 minute proper song with full lyrics.' Take 2 locked as music/locked/yaaru-nee.mp3. This brief keeps v19's hook intro, chorus, rap verse, break and punchline chunks word for word and adds two verses and pre-choruses (her side), a second rap, a bridge with humming and a duet tag. 240 s, 100 BPM, G major. Lyric sheet /mnt/project-files/music/yaaru-nee-full/yaaru-nee-full-lyrics.md. Take B: the second take, which failed on credits at 14:15; this file holds it so take 1 isn't overwritten.

story: The full song of the locked 'Yaaru nee?' short: she runs late for the metro, he spills coffee on her new dress, his sorry melts her; next day he brings two coffees, the Insta follow request stays pending three days, and it ends with 'Ippo en aalu nee!'.
